title: Crunchy Argentinian Chickpea Empanadas
description: Double-fried, crispy empanadas filled with a smoky chickpea mixture, perfect for snacking.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, puree the chickpeas, paprika, cumin, and salt until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the flour and egg. Gradually add the water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a tablespoon of the chickpea mixture in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Heat 1/2 cup of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat until hot.
Double-fry the empanadas in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Drain the empanadas on paper towels and bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy.
